roadQuality.title: Know not just where to go, but what the road will be like
roadQuality.description: Safe Road rates road surface condition based on the vehicle's body vibration while driving. Drivers prepare better for a trip, and businesses get insight into both routes and the technical condition of their fleet.
roadQuality.imageAlt: Map with color-coded road surface quality segments
roadQuality.note: The rating is based on data collected during trips.
roadQuality.vibrationNote: The same vibration data is also an indirect signal about suspension condition: sudden spikes can mean a poor road, or worn suspension parts worth checking.

analytics.title: The trip is over. The data remains.
analytics.description: Safe Road helps turn everyday trips into structured data for analysis — route history, duration, speed, distance, and body vibration data that helps monitor driving style and suspension condition.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data Safe Road receives through the safe-road.biz website, how we use it, and what rights you have. If you have any questions, contact details are at the bottom of the page.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to the safe-road.biz website — a presentation resource for Safe Road for Business. The site is operated by Individual Entrepreneur (FOP) Oleh Syrovatko (Ukrainian business registration / EDRPOU 3046902290, Nosivka, Chernihiv Oblast, Ukraine), Safe Road's developer. For privacy questions, contact sirovatkooleg@gmail.com or +380 93 594 19 84.

sections.heading: Scope of this Policy
paragraphs: This document describes how we handle data from visitors to safe-road.biz and from business connection requests.

Data collected directly by the Safe Road mobile app during trips (location, accelerometer data, device identifier) is governed by a separate in-app Privacy Policy available inside the app itself. A short summary is provided below in "Mobile app data" so business customers can review what will be collected about their drivers.

sections.heading: What data we collect on the website
paragraphs: Through the request form on the "Order" page, we receive the data you provide yourself:

sections.heading: Technical data and cookies
paragraphs: The website does not currently use third-party analytics or advertising cookies, and does not collect visitor technical data beyond standard hosting-provider logs. If we add analytics or marketing tools in the future, we will update this Policy and request your consent where required.

sections.heading: How we use the data
paragraphs: Request data is used to:
list: contact you about connecting Safe Road to your business
prepare terms and a commercial offer based on the selected plan
answer any questions included in your message

sections.heading: Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: We process request data based on the consent you give when submitting the form, and on our legitimate interest in handling a business inquiry.

sections.heading: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We do not sell request data or share it with third parties for marketing purposes.

Data may be processed by services that support handling requests and customer communication — for example, an email service or a CRM system. We require such providers to maintain an appropriate level of data protection.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
paragraphs: Request data is kept for as long as necessary to review your request and continue communicating with you, or until you ask us to delete it.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to:
list: find out what data we hold about you
withdraw consent to processing at any time
sections.note: To exercise these rights, email sirovatkooleg@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Safe Road mobile app data
paragraphs: This section is for business customers who need to understand what data the Safe Road app collects about drivers once devices are connected.
The app does not require user registration. A unique device identifier is created on first launch. The app collects:
sections.note: Data is transmitted over HTTPS and stored on a secure server. We do not share it with third parties, except where required by law or necessary for map service functionality. The full in-app Privacy Policy is available directly inside Safe Road.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data, including encrypted transmission (HTTPS). However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The website and Safe Road for Business service are aimed at companies, sole proprietors, and their representatives. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

sections.heading: Changes to this Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy. The last-updated date is shown at the top of the page. By continuing to use the site after changes, you agree to the updated version.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about this Policy, email sirovatkooleg@gmail.com or call +380 93 594 19 84.

These Terms cover the use of the website and the request process. Use of the Safe Road mobile app itself is governed by the App Store and Google Play terms, and by a separate in-app Privacy Policy.
